id.description: Unique identifier for the search input, used for accessibility and form submission

ariaLabel.description: ARIA label for the search input, used for accessibility

searchKey.description: Name of the query parameter to use for the search input value on form submission, defaults to 'q'

label.description: Label for the search input, used for accessibility

icon.description: Name of the icon to display in the search button

iconOnly.description: Forces the icon to display even on large screens

buttonVariant.description: Variant for the search button (e.g., 'primary', 'secondary', 'outline', etc.)

big.description: Whether to use the big search style with larger input and button

action.description: URL to submit the search query to

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input

defaultValue.description: Default value for the search input

onSubmit.description: JavaScript function to call on search submit, receives the search query as an argument
